tsa-a04-v01.quick_english: When the concept impresses in order, for entry into the just-told nature — then the contemplation-sequence preceded by true reason, true scripture, true teacher's instruction has use.

tsa-a04-v02.quick_english: For by concept-strength alone beings mistake themselves bound; that misapprehension is the cause obstructing saṃsāra — so the counter-pair concept arises, tearing the saṃsāra-causing concept: the cause of prosperity.

tsa-a04-v03.quick_english: Such a concept, having crossed all delimited-natured Śiva-to-end tattvas, is undelimited-consciousness-merely-formed — that is the supreme truth, the place of thing-ordering, the world's essence; by it he breathes the world — that am I, world-crossed, world-self am I.

tsa-a04-v04.quick_english: This does not arise for the māyā-blind, since true-reason and rest are absent.

tsa-a04-v05.quick_english: Viṣṇu-and-rest are limited in scripture by passion-tattva only, so even in higher vision they show no inclination toward it — therefore hostile to true-reason, scripture, teacher-instruction alone.

tsa-a04-v06.quick_english: As said in Pārameśvara: all Viṣṇu-and-rest are colored by knowledge-passion.

tsa-a04-v07.quick_english: They find not the supreme tattva, devoid of omniscient-knowledge.

tsa-a04-v08.quick_english: Therefore those pierced by the firm Śāṃbhava-descent-of-power, having impressed the concept by order of true-scripture-and-rest, enter the supreme own-nature.

tsa-a04-v09.quick_english: But then would the supreme tattva be concept-form? Not so: the concept's work is merely breaking dual-residence, fulfilled thereby; the supreme tattva is everywhere all-formed self-luminous — so no service or refutation for anyone from concept.

tsa-a04-v10.quick_english: There for the one pierced by excessively firm descent, self-attained, true-reason arises by itself — he is called initiated by the goddesses.

tsa-a04-v11.quick_english: For another, by scripture-order and the rest — with elaboration we will say in the revelation of power-descent.

tsa-a04-v12.quick_english: But the task lies in determining the teacher's scripture, and in the arising of fitting concept born of the scripture-family chain: that chain of concepts is called true-reason; it is called contemplation also — by indistinctness, existing things are contemplated as non-existent made distinct, by which.

tsa-a04-v13.quick_english: And here no other yoga-limb is directly the means apart from true-reason, light-form of pure-knowledge: of austerity-and-rest, restraint-class, nonviolence-and-rest, yama-type, retention-and-rest, breath-restraint-class — what task in consciousness by being established in the knowable merely?

tsa-a04-v14.quick_english: Withdrawal too should make the instrument-level excellent; meditation, concentration and samādhi too, performed successively by practice-order, should impart identity-with-meditated-object to the meditator.

tsa-a04-v15.quick_english: But practice in supreme-tattva, in Siva-self, own-nature, is simply not possible.

tsa-a04-v16.quick_english: For one rooted in consciousness, practice is the fixing of breath-mind-body — like bearing-load, scripture-knowing, dance-practice; but in consciousness-form nothing is to be taken, nothing removed — how then practice?

tsa-a04-v17.quick_english: If asked 'by reasoning too?' — said: this is only the mode of removing dual-residence, nothing else.

tsa-a04-v18.quick_english: Even in ordinary practice: manifesting the desired form of body-and-rest as consciousness-selfhood, and contemplating other-forms' absence — that is practice's purpose.

tsa-a04-v19.quick_english: But in supreme tattva nothing is to be discarded, it is said.

tsa-a04-v20.quick_english: Dual-residence too is not a separate thing-existing at all: it is mere own-nature-manifestation — so rejection-of-duality is done by concept, from the saying.

tsa-a04-v21.quick_english: This supreme truth, own-nature, shining, manifestation-form-nature, taken by itself from autonomy — thrown off, turned-to-expansion, expanding, expanded: by this order it shines; and shining is the Supreme Lord's own nature too — so yoga-limbs are not directly the means here.

tsa-a04-v22.quick_english: Reason may favor it, but true-reason alone is directly the means there; it is pure-knowledge too, and is impressed in many forms: offering, fire-offering, recitation, vow, yoga — therein all states' abode is the Supreme Lord alone, nothing separate exists; for establishing concept-conviction, the Supreme Lord alone is the offering-of-all-states: that is yāga; from heart-nature, for those who themselves show consciousness-entry, the offering in the Lord is easy — hence external use of flower, satisfaction, scent and rest was said.

tsa-a04-v23.quick_english: All states are made of Supreme-Lord-light: for attaining the convinced concept, in the Supreme-consciousness-fire-light, in the desire to swallow all states — sudden becoming mere light-residue, dissolution of all states: fire-offering.

tsa-a04-v24.quick_english: Likewise, for the arising of both-natured contemplation, by disregard alone of states divided by outer-inner-knowable forms: this supreme tattva is own-nature-formed — inner contemplation: recitation.

tsa-a04-v25.quick_english: Everywhere always, for gaining impersonal Supreme-Lord-identification, by identification with equality to the Lord: viewing even the body, even pot-and-rest: vow.

tsa-a04-v26.quick_english: As said in Śrī-Nandiśikhā: all-equality is the supreme vow.

tsa-a04-v27.quick_english: Thus by various pure-knowledge-portion-formed concepts, what concept-independent natural supreme-truth-tattva shines — for establishment in being merely eternal-such-shining, the concept specific to own-nature-tracking: yoga.

tsa-a04-v28.quick_english: Therein the Supreme-Lord, full-consciousness-natured — fullness his power, clan, capability, wave, heart, essence, pulsation, glory, triad, Kālī, Karṣaṇī, Caṇḍī, Vāṇī, enjoyment, vision, Nityā and rest — is denoted by scripture-languages running according to each sense; by that, by that form, in the hearts of meditators let it be.

tsa-a04-v29.quick_english: She, by seeing whole-power-nature, shines as fullness-consciousness.

tsa-a04-v31.quick_english: Why say more? The world — those are his powers; how can they be taught?

tsa-a04-v32.quick_english: In three the world is completed: by which this bears, sees, illumines up to Śiva-bearer-limit as mere uncaricatured-consciousness-form — the Supreme Lord; that is his Śrīparā-power.

tsa-a04-v33.quick_english: By which, like mirror-elephant and rest, by difference-undifference: that is his Śrīparāparā-power.

tsa-a04-v34.quick_english: By which, by self-distinct-from-each-other, by difference alone: that is his Śrīmadaparā-power.

tsa-a04-v35.quick_english: The threefold holding of this, in self, by embracing, by tracking-nature, grasps: she is the Goddess Śrīparā herself, named by other words such as Śrīmat-mātṛ-sat-bhāva-kāla-karṣiṇī.

tsa-a04-v36.quick_english: These four powers, from autonomy, each operate threefold alone.

tsa-a04-v37.quick_english: In creation, preservation and dissolution — twelve they become.

tsa-a04-v38.quick_english: Thus consciousness first constructs the state within; then outside too by distinctness; taking reddened-nature right there; then intends to reabsorb that state within; then forms the doubt obstacle-to-reabsorption and grasps it; the doubt-grasped portion, state-portion, he constructs in self by reabsorption; then constructs even my-this-form reabsorber-nature as own-nature; then in constructing reabsorber-nature, some state's standing by habit-nature, some's consciousness-merely-residue-nature; then by being inseparable from own-nature-constructing, the instrument-wheel; then even the instrument-Lord; then the constructed māyic knower-form; then the knower contraction-release-turned-expansion-grasp-taste-bearing; therefore even expanded form he constructs — thus these twelve Goddess-consciousnesses, targeting knower-objects one or even, simultaneously or in order, two-wise, three-wise, even-standing, arising-portioned, revolving like-wheel, outside too by order of month-segment-asterism-and-rest, within too by order of pot-cloth-and-rest, shining, nourishing the wheel-Lord's autonomy, denoted-by-Śrīkālī-word.

tsa-a04-v39.quick_english: And construction is motion, throw, knowledge, counting, enjoyment-making, sound, self-dissolving too.

tsa-a04-v40.quick_english: As the Śrībhūtirāja-teachers say: from throw and from knowledge Kālī, by subjection to construction then.

tsa-a04-v41.quick_english: And this meaning is to be considered, spread here and there in my composed commentary, in treatise-hymn-and-rest.

tsa-a04-v42.quick_english: Not too-secret to be shown somewhere, nor to be hidden in any way — so our teachers.

tsa-a04-v43.quick_english: Thus what was said: offering, fire-offering and rest — in this kind the Great-Lord alone is to be thought.

tsa-a04-v44.quick_english: All see Viṣṇu-to-Siva as to-be-rejected only, ground-form of to-be-accepted, by Parameśvara-nature; and that false-view is necessarily abandoned by unsurpassable-yogins — for that very sake the knowledge-Lord's great fervour in the hymn-of-experience: in this kind, in offering-and-rest, at yoga-end, in the fivefold, each many-form establishment; as it becomes, so let him practise — not by discrimination of edible-inedible-clean-unclean-and-rest, by abandoning thing-qualities, by fancy-merely-essence tormenting own-self — so said in Śrīpūrva-and-rest. For purity is not a thing's form like blueness elsewhere, from command-of-impurity on it; like gift's command in initiation — if 'that is impure there' by another command too the same, other-command not-existing from being-overridden — if not, Siva's-command's obstructive-power alone is established-by-reason, established by omniscient-unsurpassable-endless-scripture too — we will say.

tsa-a04-v45.quick_english: Therefore from Vedic on, spoken in Pārameśvara-system-tantra-clan-Ucchuṣma-and-rest-scripture too, whatever restraint or injunction or prohibition — here it is established of no effect whatsoever.

tsa-a04-v46.quick_english: Likewise said in Śrīpūrva-and-rest, spread — from Tantrāloka to be sought.

tsa-a04-v01.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v01.question: When does vikalpa have use?
premises: yadā vikalpaṃ krameṇa saṃskurute — when the concept impresses in order.
samanantaroktasvarūpapraveśāya — for entry into the just-told nature.
bhāvanākramasya sattarkasadāgamasadgurūpadeśapūrvakasya asti upayogaḥ — the contemplation-sequence preceded by true reason/scripture/teacher has use.
tsa-a04-v01.inference: Vikalpa's use is conditional: sequence-impressed, triply-preceded (sattarka-sadāgama-sadguru).

tsa-a04-v02.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v02.question: How does vikalpa both bind and free?
premises: vikalpabalāt eva jantavo baddham ātmānam abhimanyante — by concept-strength beings mistake the self bound.
sa abhimānaḥ saṃsārapratibandhahetuḥ — that misapprehension obstructs saṃsāra.
pratidvandvirūpo vikalpa uditaḥ saṃsārahetuṃ vikalpaṃ dalayati — counter-pair concept tears the saṃsāra-causing concept.
iti abhyudayahetuḥ — hence prosperity-cause.
tsa-a04-v02.inference: The same instrument binds or frees: pair-opposed vikalpa dissolves the binding one.

tsa-a04-v03.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v03.question: What is the concept that has crossed?
premises: samastebhyaḥ paricchinnasvabhāvebhyaḥ śivāntebhyaḥ tattvebhyo yat uttīrṇam — crossed all delimited Śiva-to-end tattvas.
aparicchinnasaṃvinmātrarūpam — undelimited-consciousness-merely-formed.
tat eva ca paramārthaḥ — that is the supreme truth.
tat vastuvyavasthāsthānam, tat viśvasya ojaḥ — place of thing-ordering, world's essence.
tena prāṇiti viśvam — by it he breathes the world.
aham ato viśvottīrṇo viśvātmā ca aham — world-crossed, world-self am I.
tsa-a04-v03.inference: Crossing yields the aham-identity: undelimited saṃvid IS paramārtha, the world's ojas and breath.

tsa-a04-v04.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v04.question: Who does not get this?
premises: sa ca ayaṃ māyāndhānāṃ na utpadyate — this does not arise for the māyā-blind.
sattarkādīnām abhāvāt — from absence of true-reason and rest.
tsa-a04-v04.inference: Māyā-blindness = absence of the sattarka-lineage; nothing else excludes them.

tsa-a04-v05.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v05.question: Why are Vaiṣṇava-type āgamas limited?
premises: vaiṣṇavādyā hi tāvanmātra eva āgame rāgatattvena niyamitāḥ — limited in scripture by passion-tattva only.
na ūrdhvadarśane 'pi tadunmukhatāṃ bhajante — even in higher vision no inclination.
tataḥ sattarkadveṣiṇa eva — therefore hostile to true-reason and rest.
tsa-a04-v05.inference: Passion-limitation breeds hostility upward: the Vaiṣṇava-type cannot turn toward sattarka.

tsa-a04-v06.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v06.question: What does Pārameśvara say?
premises: yathoktaṃ pārameśvare — as said in Pārameśvara.
vaiṣṇavādyāḥ samastās te vidyārāgeṇa rañjitāḥ — all Vaiṣṇu-and-rest colored by knowledge-passion.
tsa-a04-v06.inference: Cited authority: their color is vidyā-rāga, not neutral knowledge.

tsa-a04-v07.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v07.question: What do they lack?
premises: na vindanti paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvajñajñānavarjitāḥ — they find not supreme tattva, devoid of omniscient-knowledge.
tsa-a04-v07.inference: Deficiency stated: no sarvajña-jñāna, hence no parama-tattva.

tsa-a04-v08.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v08.question: Who enters the supreme own-nature?
premises: tasmāt śāṃbhavadṛḍhaśaktipātāviddhā eva — only those pierced by firm Śāṃbhava-descent.
sadāgamādikrameṇa vikalpaṃ saṃskṛtya — impressing concept by true-scripture-order.
paraṃ svarūpaṃ praviśanti — they enter supreme own-nature.
tsa-a04-v08.inference: Entry-condition: firm śaktipāta + ordered vikalpa-saṃskāra — both required.

tsa-a04-v09.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v09.question: Is parama-tattva then concept-form?
premises: nanu itthaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ vikalpyarūpaṃ syāt — but then would it be concept-form?
maivam — not so.
vikalpasya dvaitādhivāsabhaṅgamātre caritārthatvāt — concept's purpose is merely breaking dual-residence.
paraṃ tattvaṃ tu sarvatra sarvarūpatayā svaprakāśam — supreme is everywhere all-formed self-luminous.
na tatra vikalpaḥ kasyacit upakriyāyai khaṇḍanāyai vā — no service or refutation for anyone.
tsa-a04-v09.inference: Concept is soteriological tool, not metaphysical constituent: its work ends at dvaita-bhanga.

tsa-a04-v10.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v10.question: Who gets sattarka spontaneously?
premises: atidṛḍhaśaktipātāviddhasya svayam eva sāṃsiddhikatayā sattarka udeti — for the firmly-pierced, self-attained true-reason arises.
yo 'sau devībhiḥ dīkṣita iti ucyate — he is called initiated by the goddesses.
tsa-a04-v10.inference: Sattarka-arising = devī-dīkṣā: the spontaneous type is goddess-initiated.

tsa-a04-v11.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v11.question: What about everyone else?
premises: anyasya āgamakrameṇa — for another, by scripture-order.
savistaraṃ śaktipātaprakāśane vakṣyāmaḥ — with elaboration in power-descent-revelation.
tsa-a04-v11.inference: Two tracks: spontaneous (devī-dīkṣā) vs sequential (āgama-krama) — full treatment deferred.

tsa-a04-v12.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v12.question: Where does the sattarka-task actually lie?
premises: guror āgamanirūpaṇe vyāpāraḥ — task in determining the teacher's scripture.
āgamasya ca ... samucitavikalpayodaye vyāpāraḥ — and in fitting-concept arising from the scripture-chain.
tathāvidhavikalpaprabandha eva sattarka — that concept-chain IS true-reason.
sa eva ca bhāvanā bhaṇyate asphuṭatvāt — called contemplation too, from indistinctness.
bhūtam api artham abhūtam iva sphuṭatvāpādanena bhāvyate — existents contemplated as non-existent made distinct.
tsa-a04-v12.inference: Sattarka = chain-concept of fitting scriptural sense; bhāvanā = its indistinct-mode (making existent look non-existent).

tsa-a04-v13.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v13.question: Do yoga-limbs serve as direct means here?
premises: na ca atra sattarkāt ... ṛte anyat yogāṅgaṃ sākṣāt upāyaḥ — no other yoga-limb is direct means apart from sattarka.
tapaḥprabhṛteḥ niyamavargasya ahiṃsādeś ca yamaprakārasya pūrakādeḥ prāṇāyāmavargasya — austerity/restraint/nonviolence/yama/retention/prāṇāyāma classes.
vedyamātraniṣṭhatvena ka iva saṃvidi vyāpāraḥ — what task in consciousness by knowing-merely-niṣṭhā?
tsa-a04-v13.inference: Limb-practices are object-level (vedya-mātra); sattarka alone operates in saṃvid.

tsa-a04-v14.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v14.question: Do the limbs still have a place?
premises: pratyāhāro 'pi karaṇabhūmim eva sātiśayāṃ kuryāt — withdrawal makes the instrument-level excellent.
dhyānadhāraṇāsamādhayo 'pi yathottaram abhyāsakrameṇa — meditation/concentration/samādhi successively by practice.
dhyeyavastutādātmyaṃ dhyātuḥ vitareyuḥ — they impart identity-with-meditated-object.
tsa-a04-v14.inference: Limbs are subordinate but real: they excellence the karaṇa-bhūmi and transfer tādātmya.

tsa-a04-v15.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v15.question: Can abhyāsa exist in parama-tattva?
premises: abhyāsaś ca pare tattve śivātmani svasvabhāve na saṃbhavaty eva — practice in supreme, Siva-self, own-nature is simply not possible.
tsa-a04-v15.inference: Practice presupposes otherness: in svasvabhāva it cannot arise — category-boundary.

tsa-a04-v16.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v16.question: What is abhyāsa for the saṃvid-rooted?
premises: saṃvidrūḍhasya prāṇabuddhidehaniṣṭhīkaraṇarūpaḥ hi abhyāsaḥ — for the rooted, practice = fixing breath-mind-body.
bhārodvahanaśāstrārthabodhanṛttābhyāsavat — like carrying-load/scripture-knowing/dance-practice.
saṃvidrūpe tu na kiṃcit ādātavyam na apasaraṇīyam — in consciousness-form: nothing taken, nothing removed.
katham abhyāsaḥ — how then practice?
tsa-a04-v16.inference: Two registers: niṣṭhā-fixing (body-level) possible; saṃvid-level 'practice' is incoherent by definition.

tsa-a04-v17.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v17.question: Does reasoning (tarka) also do this work?
premises: kiṃ tarkeṇāpi iti cet — if asked: by reasoning too?
uktam atra dvaitādhivāsanirāsaprakāra eva ayaṃ na tu anyat kiṃcit — said: this is only the mode of removing dual-residence, nothing else.
tsa-a04-v17.inference: Tarka admitted only as dvaita-nirāsa-prakāra — instrumental, not constitutive.

tsa-a04-v18.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v18.question: What is the meaning of abhyāsa even in the laukika?
premises: laukike 'pi abhyāse cidātmatvena sarvarūpasya — even ordinary practice as consciousness-selfhood of all-form.
dehādeḥ abhimatarūpatāprakaṭīkaraṇam — manifesting desired form of body-and-rest.
taditararūpanyagbhāvanaṃ ca — and contemplating other-forms' absence.
eṣa eva abhyāsārthaḥ — that is practice's purpose.
tsa-a04-v18.inference: Laukika-abhyāsa = cid-ātmatā-manifestation + anya-rūpa-nyāga — same structure, ordinary content.

tsa-a04-v19.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v19.question: What is discarded in para-tattva?
premises: paratattve tu na kiṃcit apāsyam — in supreme tattva nothing is to be discarded.
tsa-a04-v19.inference: Apāsya is zero there: negation-work belongs to dvaita, not parama.

tsa-a04-v20.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v20.question: What exactly is dvaitādhivāsa?
premises: dvaitādhivāso 'pi nāma na kaścana pṛthak vastubhūtaḥ — not a separate thing-existing.
api tu svarūpākhyātimātram — mere own-nature-manifestation.
ato dvaitāpāsanaṃ vikalpena kriyata ity ukteḥ — hence rejection-by-concept, from the saying.
tsa-a04-v20.inference: Dvaita-residence is epistemic (ākhyāti-mātra), so its removal is vikalpa-work, not thing-work.

tsa-a04-v21.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v21.question: How does paramārtha shine, and what follows for yoga-limbs?
premises: ayaṃ paramārthaḥ svarūpaṃ prakāśamānam akhyātirūpatvam — this paramārtha: own-nature shining as manifestation-form.
svayaṃ svātantryāt gṛhītam — taken by itself from autonomy.
krameṇa projjhya vikāsonmukham atha vikasat atha vikasitam — thrown-off, turned-to-expansion, expanding, expanded: by this order.
prakāśanam api parameśvarasya svarūpam eva — shining is the Lord's own nature too.
tasmāt na atra yogāṅgāni sākṣāt upāyaḥ — so yoga-limbs are not direct means here.
tsa-a04-v21.inference: The shining-order (projjhya-vikāsa) is svarūpa itself; limbs mediate but do not cause it.

tsa-a04-v22.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v22.question: What is sattarka's relation to yāga etc.?
premises: tarkaṃ tu anugṛhṇīyur api sattarka eva sākṣāt upāyaḥ — even favoring tarka, sattarka alone direct means.
sa eva ca śuddhavidyā sa ca bahuprakāratayā saṃskṛto — sattarka is pure-knowledge, impressed in many forms: yāga, homa, japa, vrata, yoga.
tatra bhāvānāṃ sarveṣāṃ parameśvara eva sthitiḥ — there all states' abode is the Lord alone.
vikalparūḍhisiddhaye parameśvara eva sarvabhāvārpaṇaṃ yāgaḥ — for concept-conviction, offering-all-states to Lord = yāga.
hṛdyatvāt ... suśakaṃ parameśvare arpaṇam — from heart-nature, offering in Lord is easy; hence external flower/scent use.
tsa-a04-v22.inference: The five practices are sattarka's impress-forms; each = sarvabhāva-arpaṇa to parameśvara, externally scaffolded for heart-nature.

tsa-a04-v23.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v23.question: What is homa here?
premises: sarve bhāvāḥ parameśvaratejomayā — all states made of Lord-light.
rūḍhavikalpaprāptyai parameśasaṃvidanalatejasi — for convicted-concept-attaining, in Lord-consciousness-fire-light.
samastabhāvagrāsarasikatābhimate — in all-state-swallowing-taste-desire.
tattejomātrāvaśeṣatvasahasamastabhāvavilāpanaṃ homaḥ — sudden all-states-dissolution-to-merely-light-residue: fire-offering.
tsa-a04-v23.inference: Homa = vilāpa into tejaḥ-mātra-avaśeṣa under the grāsa-rasa of Lord-consciousness.

tsa-a04-v24.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v24.question: What is japa here?
premises: ubhayātmakaparāmarśodayārthaṃ — for arising of both-natured contemplation.
bāhyābhyantarādiprameyarūpabhinnabhāvānapekṣayaiva — by disregard alone of forms divided outer/inner-knowable.
evaṃvidhaṃ tat paraṃ tattvaṃ svasvabhāvabhūtam — this supreme tattva is own-nature-formed.
antaḥ parāmarśanaṃ japaḥ — inner contemplation: recitation.
tsa-a04-v24.inference: Japa = antaḥ-parāmarśana with bāhya/abhyantara-bheda disregarded — both-aspect contemplation.

tsa-a04-v25.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v25.question: What is vrata here?
premises: sarvatra sarvadā nirupāyaparameśvarābhimānalābhāya — for gaining impersonal Lord-identification everywhere-always.
parameśvarasamatābhimānena — by equality-identification.
dehasyāpi ghaṭāder api avalokanaṃ vratam — viewing even body, even pot: vow.
tsa-a04-v25.inference: Vrata = samatā-bhimāna extended to pot-viewing: object-level equalization.

tsa-a04-v26.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v26.question: What authority for samatā?
premises: yathoktaṃ śrīnandiśikhāyām — as said in Śrī-Nandiśikhā.
sarvasāmyaṃ paraṃ vratam — all-equality the supreme vow.
tsa-a04-v26.inference: Cited: sarvasāmya is the para-vrata — authority for u25.

tsa-a04-v27.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v27.question: What is yoga here?
premises: vicitraiḥ śuddhavidyāṃśarūpaiḥ vikalpaiḥ — by various pure-knowledge-portion concepts.
yat anapekṣitavikalpaṃ svābhāvikaṃ paramārthatattvaṃ prakāśate — what concept-independent natural paramārtha-tattva shines.
tasyaiva sanātanatathāvidhaprakāśamātratārūḍhaye — for establishment in being merely eternal-such-shining.
tatsvarūpānusaṃdhānātmā vikalpaviśeṣo yogaḥ — the specific concept of own-nature-tracking: yoga.
tsa-a04-v27.inference: Yoga = vikalpa-viśeṣa tracking svarūpa until the paramārtha shines concept-independently — self-liquidating instrument.

tsa-a04-v28.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v28.question: How is parameśvara denoted in āgama-language?
premises: parameśvaraḥ pūrṇasaṃvitsvabhāvaḥ — full-consciousness-natured.
pūrṇataiva asya śaktiḥ — fullness is his power; kula, sāmarthyam, ūrmi, hṛdaya, sāra, spanda, vibhūti.
trīśikā kālī karṣaṇī caṇḍī vāṇī bhogo dṛk nityā ityādibhiḥ āgamabhāṣābhiḥ — by scripture-language names.
tadadanvarthapravṛttābhiḥ abhidhīyate — denoted running according to each sense.
tena tena rūpeṇa dhyāyināṃ hṛdi āstām — in each form let it be in meditators' hearts.
tsa-a04-v28.inference: Each āgama-name is an anvartha-projection of pūrṇasaṃvit — denotation is perspectival, referent one.

tsa-a04-v29.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v29.question: How does pūrṇatā-consciousness shine?
premises: sā ca samagraśaktitādarśanena pūrṇatāsaṃvit prakāśate — by seeing whole-power-nature, fullness-consciousness shines.
tsa-a04-v29.inference: Darśana of samagra-śakti-tā is the condition of pūrṇatā-saṃvid manifestation.

tsa-a04-v30.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v30.question: How many powers?
premises: śaktayaś ca asya asaṃkhyeyāḥ — his powers are countless.
tsa-a04-v30.inference: Countless in general; the structured twelve/four-counts follow as specific schemes.

tsa-a04-v31.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v31.question: Can the powers be taught?
premises: kiṃ bahunā — why say more.
yat viśvaṃ tā asya śaktayaḥ — the world: those are his powers.
tāḥ katham upadeṣṭuṃ śakyāḥ — how can they be taught?
tsa-a04-v31.inference: Rhetorical: world = powers = unteachable-as-list — sets up the counted schemes as approximation.

tsa-a04-v32.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v32.question: Which power completes the world in three?
premises: tisṛṣu tāvat viśvaṃ samāpyate — in three the world is completed.
yayā idaṃ śivādidharaṇyantam avikalpyasaṃvinmātrarūpatayā bibharti ca paśyati ca bhāsayati ca — bears/sees/illuminates as mere uncaricatured saṃvid up to Śiva-limit.
parameśvaraḥ — the Supreme Lord.
sā asya śrīparaśaktiḥ — that is his Śrīparā-power.
tsa-a04-v32.inference: Śrīparā = the triadic bearer-seer-illuminator in avikalpa-saṃvid-rūpa.

tsa-a04-v33.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v33.question: Which power works by difference-undifference?
premises: yayā ca darpaṇahastyādivat bhedābhedābhyām — by which, like mirror-elephant, by difference-undifference.
sā asya śrīparāparaśaktiḥ — that is his Śrīparāparā-power.
tsa-a04-v33.inference: Śrīparāparā = the bheda/abheda-relation power (mirror-model echoes a03).

tsa-a04-v34.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v34.question: Which power works by difference alone?
premises: yayā parasparaviviktātmanā bhedenaiva — by self-distinct-from-each-other, difference alone.
sā asya śrīmadaparaśaktiḥ — that is his Śrīmadaparā-power.

tsa-a04-v35.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v35.question: Which power holds the threefold in self?
premises: etat trividhaṃ yayā dhāraṇam ātmany eva kroḍīkāreṇa anusandhānātmanā grasate — by which the threefold is held in self by embracing, tracking-nature.
sā asya bhagavatī śrīparā eva — she is the Goddess Śrīparā herself.
śrīmanmātṛsadbhāvakālakarṣiṇyādiśabdāntaraniruktā — named by other words Śrīmat-mātṛ-sat-bhāva-kāla-karṣiṇī.
tsa-a04-v35.inference: Śrīparā double-duty: the triadic bearer (u32) AND the kroḍī-holder of the three — same Goddess, two functions.

tsa-a04-v36.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v36.question: How do the four powers operate?
premises: tā etāḥ catasraḥ śaktayaḥ — these four powers.
svātantryāt pratyekaṃ tridhaiva vartante — from autonomy each operates threefold alone.
tsa-a04-v36.inference: 4×3 = the structure: each power triples by svātantrya.

tsa-a04-v37.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v37.question: What do they become?
premises: sṛṣṭau sthitau saṃhāre ca — in creation, preservation, dissolution.
iti dvādaśa bhavanti — twelve they become.
tsa-a04-v37.inference: 4×3=12: the twelve are the cosmogonic matrix (feeds u38's twelve Goddesses).

tsa-a04-v38.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v38.question: What is the twelve-fold saṃvit-kalana?
premises: saṃvit pūrvam antar eva bhāvaṃ kalayati — consciousness first constructs the state within.
tato bahir api sphuṭatayā — then outside by distinctness.
raktimayatāṃ gṛhītvā ... upasaṃjihīrṣayā — taking reddened-nature, intending reabsorption.
śaṅkāṃ nirmiṇoti ca grasate ca — forms and grasps the reabsorption-obstacle doubt.
grastaśaṅkāṃśaṃ bhāvabhāgam ātmani upasaṃhāreṇa kalayati — doubt-portion reabsorbed in self.
upasaṃhartṛtvaṃ mamedaṃ rūpam ... svabhāvam eva kalayati — constructs my-this-form reabsorber as own-nature.
kasyacid bhāvasya vāsanātmanā avasthitiṃ, kasyacit tu saṃvinmātrāvaśeṣatāṃ — some states habit-standing, some consciousness-residue.

karaṇacakraṃ ... karaṇeśvaram ... māyīyaṃ pramātṛrūpam ... saṅkocatyāgonmukhavikāsagrahaṇarasikam pramātāram ... vikasitam api rūpaṃ kalayati — constructs wheel, Lord, māyic knower, contraction-expansion-taste knower, expanded form.
etā dvādaśa bhagavatyaḥ saṃvidaḥ — these twelve Goddess-consciousnesses.
yugapat krameṇa dviśaḥ triśa ityādisthityāpi udayabhāginyaḥ cakravad āvartamānā — simultaneous/sequential, two/three-wise, revolving like-wheel.
māsakalārāśyādikrameṇa ... ghaṭapaṭādikrameṇāpi bhāsamānāḥ — by month/asterism order, pot/cloth order too.
cakreśvarasya svātantryaṃ puṣṇatyaḥ śrīkālīśabdavācyāḥ — nourishing the wheel-Lord's autonomy, denoted Śrīkālī.
tsa-a04-v38.inference: The twelve-fold kalana is saṃvid's full constructive cycle (in→out→doubt→reabsorb→knower-forms→expanded form), operating wheel-wise at cosmic and domestic scales — Śrīkālī is its name.

tsa-a04-v39.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v39.question: What counts as kalana?
premises: kalanaṃ ca gatiḥ kṣepo jñānaṃ gaṇanaṃ bhogīkaraṇaṃ śabdaṃ svātmalayīkaraṇaṃ ca — motion, throw, knowledge, counting, enjoyment-making, sound, self-dissolving.
tsa-a04-v39.inference: Seven listed operations define kalana's semantic range — construction includes motion and dissolution.

tsa-a04-v40.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v40.question: What do the Bhūtirāja-teachers say?
premises: yad āhuḥ śrībhūtirājaguravaḥ — as the Śrībhūtirāja-teachers say.
kṣepāj jñānāc ca kālī — from throw and from knowledge Kālī.
kalanavaśatayātha — by subjection to construction then.
tsa-a04-v40.inference: Cited: Kālī = kṣepa-jñāna pair under kalana-vaśa — authority for the kalana-encoding of time-power.

tsa-a04-v41.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v41.question: Where is this meaning elaborated?
premises: eṣa ca arthaḥ tatra tatra madviracite vivaraṇe — this meaning in my composed commentary here and there.
prakaraṇastotrādau vitatya vīkṣyaḥ — spread in treatise-hymn-and-rest, to be considered.
tsa-a04-v41.inference: Self-citation: the doctrine is distributed across Abhinavagupta's own vivaraṇa-corpus.

tsa-a04-v42.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v42.question: How secret is it?
premises: na atirahasyam ekatra khyāpyam — not too-secret to be shown somewhere.
na ca sarvathā gopyam — nor to be hidden in any way.
hi asmadguravaḥ — so our teachers.
tsa-a04-v42.inference: House-rule: neither over-secret nor fully public — disclosure is graduated by context.

tsa-a04-v43.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v43.question: What follows for yāga-homa practice?
premises: yad uktaṃ yāgahomādi — what was said: offering, fire-offering and rest.
tat evaṃvidhe maheśvara eva mantavyam — in this kind the Great-Lord alone is to be thought.
tsa-a04-v43.inference: All ritual action re-presents maheśvara-only: the object of meditation during practice.

tsa-a04-v44.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v44.question: What is the fierce argument about purity-rules?
premises: sarve hi heya eva upādeyabhūmirūpaṃ viṣṇutaḥ prabhṛti śivāntam — all see Viṣṇu-to-Siva as to-be-rejected ground-form.
tac ca mithyādarśanam avaśyatyājyam anuttarayogibhir — that false-view necessarily abandoned by unsurpassable-yogins.
tadartham eva vidyādhipateḥ anubhavastotre mahān saṃrambhaḥ — hence the knowledge-Lord's great fervour in hymn-of-experience.
yathā yathā bhavati tathaiva ācaret — as it becomes, so let him practise.
na tu bhakṣyābhakṣyaśuddhyaśuddhyādivivecanayā vastudharmojjhitayā kalpanāmātrasārayā svātmā khedanīyaḥ — not by purity-discriminations tormenting self by fancy-essence.
na hi śuddhiḥ vastuno rūpaṃ nīlatvavat anyatra — purity is not a thing-form like blueness elsewhere.
dānasyeva dīkṣitatve codanātaḥ — like gift's command in initiation.
codanāntare 'pi tulyam ... na śivacodanāyā eva bādhakatvaṃ — other-commands equal; Siva's-command alone obstructs.
yuktisiddhaṃ sarvajñānottarādyanantāgamasiddham ca — established by reason and endless scripture; we will say.
tsa-a04-v44.inference: Purity-rules are command-relative (codanā-vaśa), not thing-intrinsic; mithyā-darśana of heya/upādeya is what must go — the anubhava-stotra's fervour targets exactly this.

tsa-a04-v45.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v45.question: Do Vedic and other śāstra-restraints bind here?
premises: tasmāt vaidikāt prabhṛti pārameśvarasiddhāntatantrakulocchuṣmādiśāstrokto 'pi — from Vedic through Pārameśvara/tantra/clan/Ucchuṣma scriptures.
yo niyamo vidhiḥ vā niṣedhaḥ vā — whatever restraint, injunction, prohibition.
so 'tra yāvad akiṃcitkara eva — here it is of no effect whatsoever.
iti siddham — established.
tsa-a04-v45.inference: Radical scope: all hetero-scriptural restraint is akiṃcitkara within this system — only śiva-codanā binds.

tsa-a04-v46.speaker: Teacher (vikalpa-sattarka-sakti doctrine)
tsa-a04-v46.question: Where does the authority point?
premises: tathaiva ca uktaṃ śrīpūrvādau — likewise said in Śrīpūrva-and-rest.
vitatya tantrālokāt anveṣyam — spread, from Tantrāloka to be sought.
tsa-a04-v46.inference: Forward/backward pointer: cross-search Tantrāloka for the full spread of this claim.

tsa-a04-v01.plain_english: When the concept impresses in order, for entry into the nature just told — then the contemplation-sequence, preceded by true reason, true scripture and the true teacher's instruction, has its use.
tsa-a04-v01.sanskrit_cite: tatra yadā vikalpaṃ krameṇa saṃskurute samanantaroktasvarūpapraveśāya tadā bhāvanākramasya sattarkasadāgamasadgurūpadeśapūrvakasya asti upayogaḥ

tsa-a04-v02.plain_english: For by concept-strength alone beings mistake themselves to be bound; that misapprehension is the cause that obstructs saṃsāra — so the counter-pair concept arises: it tears the saṃsāra-causing concept, and is the cause of prosperity.
tsa-a04-v02.sanskrit_cite: tathā hi vikalpabalāt eva jantavo baddham ātmānam abhimanyante sa abhimānaḥ saṃsārapratibandhahetuḥ ataḥ pratidvandvirūpo vikalpa uditaḥ saṃsārahetuṃ vikalpaṃ dalayati iti abhyudayahetuḥ

tsa-a04-v03.plain_english: Such a concept, having crossed all the delimited-natured tattvas from Śiva to the limit, is undelimited-consciousness-merely-formed — that is the supreme truth, the place where thing-ordering stands, the world's essence; by it he breathes the world — that am I, world-crossed, world-self am I.
tsa-a04-v03.sanskrit_cite: sa ca evaṃrūpaḥ samastebhyaḥ paricchinnasvabhāvebhyaḥ śivāntebhyaḥ tattvebhyo yat uttīrṇam aparicchinnasaṃvinmātrarūpaṃ tad eva ca paramārthaḥ tat vastuvyavasthāsthānaṃ tat viśvasya ojaḥ tena prāṇiti viśvam tad eva ca aham ato viśvottīrṇo viśvātmā ca aham iti

tsa-a04-v04.plain_english: And this does not arise for the māyā-blind, since true-reason and the rest are absent.
tsa-a04-v04.sanskrit_cite: sa ca ayaṃ māyāndhānāṃ na utpadyate sattarkādīnām abhāvāt

tsa-a04-v05.plain_english: For Viṣṇu-and-rest are limited in scripture by passion-tattva only, so even in higher vision they show no inclination toward it — therefore they are hostile to true-reason, true scripture and true teacher-instruction alone.
tsa-a04-v05.sanskrit_cite: vaiṣṇavādyā hi tāvanmātra eva āgame rāgatattvena niyamitā iti na ūrdhvadarśane 'pi tadunmukhatāṃ bhajante tataḥ sattarkasadāgamasadgurūpadeśadveṣiṇa eva

tsa-a04-v06.plain_english: As said in the Pārameśvara: all Viṣṇu-and-rest are colored by knowledge-passion.
tsa-a04-v06.sanskrit_cite: yathoktaṃ pārameśvare vaiṣṇavādyāḥ samastās te vidyārāgeṇa rañjitāḥ

tsa-a04-v07.plain_english: They do not find the supreme tattva, being devoid of omniscient knowledge.
tsa-a04-v07.sanskrit_cite: na vindanti paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvajñajñānavarjitāḥ iti

tsa-a04-v08.plain_english: Therefore only those pierced by the firm descent of Śāṃbhava-power, having impressed the concept by the order of true scripture and the rest, enter the supreme own-nature.
tsa-a04-v08.sanskrit_cite: tasmāt śāṃbhavadṛḍḥaśaktipātāviddhā eva sadāgamādikrameṇa vikalpaṃ saṃskṛtya paraṃ svarūpaṃ praviśanti

tsa-a04-v09.plain_english: But then would the supreme tattva be of concept-form? Not so: the concept's work is fulfilled merely in breaking the residence-in-duality; the supreme tattva, however, is everywhere all-formed and self-luminous — so there is no service or refutation of it for anyone from concept.
tsa-a04-v09.sanskrit_cite: nanu itthaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ vikalpyarūpaṃ syāt maivam vikalpasya dvaitādhivāsabhaṅgamātre caritārthatvāt paraṃ tattvaṃ tu sarvatra sarvarūpatayā svaprakāśam eva iti na tatra vikalpaḥ kasyaicit upakriyāyai khaṇḍanāyai vā

tsa-a04-v10.plain_english: There, for one pierced by an excessively firm descent of power, true-reason arises by itself through self-attainment — he is called one initiated by the goddesses.
tsa-a04-v10.sanskrit_cite: tatra atidṛḍhaśaktipātāviddhasya svayam eva sāṃsiddhikatayā sattarka udeti yo 'sau devībhiḥ dīkṣita iti ucyate

tsa-a04-v11.plain_english: For another, by the order of scripture — with elaboration we will say this in the revelation of power-descent.
tsa-a04-v11.sanskrit_cite: anyasya āgamakrameṇa ityādi savistaraṃ śaktipātaprakāśane vakṣyāmaḥ

tsa-a04-v12.plain_english: But the task lies in determining the teacher's scripture, and in the arising of the fitting concept that is born of the scripture's chain of kin: that chain of concepts is called true-reason; it is called contemplation as well, since from indistinctness an existing thing is contemplated as non-existent by being made distinct.
tsa-a04-v12.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ tu guror āgamanirūpaṇe vyāpāraḥ āgamasya ca niḥśaṅkasajātīyatatprabandhaprasavanibandhanasamucitavikalpodaye vyāpāraḥ tathāvidhavikalpaprabandha eva sattarka iti uktaḥ sa eva ca bhāvanā bhaṇyate asphuṭatvāt bhūtam api artham abhūtam iva sphuṭatvāpādanena bhāvyate yayā iti

tsa-a04-v13.plain_english: And here no other yoga-limb is a direct means apart from true-reason, the light-form of pure knowledge: of austerity and the rest, of the restraint-class, of nonviolence and the rest — the yama-type, of retention and the rest, the prāṇāyāma-class — what task is there in consciousness by being established in the knowable merely?
tsa-a04-v13.sanskrit_cite: na ca atra sattarkāt śuddhavidyāprakāśarūpāt ṛte anyat yogāṅgaṃ sākṣāt upāyaḥ tapaḥprabhṛteḥ niyamavargasya ahiṃsādeś ca yamaprakārasya pūrakādeḥ prāṇāyāmavargasya vedyamātraniṣṭhatvena ka iva saṃvidi vyāpāraḥ

tsa-a04-v14.plain_english: Withdrawal too should make the instrument-level excellent; meditation, concentration and samādhi too, performed successively by the order of practice, should impart identity-with-the-meditated-object to the meditator.
tsa-a04-v14.sanskrit_cite: pratyāhāro 'pi karaṇabhūmim eva sātiśayāṃ kuryāt dhyānadhāraṇāsamādhayo 'pi yathottaram abhyāsakrameṇa nirvartyamānā dhyeyavastutādātmyaṃ dhyātuḥ vitareyuḥ

tsa-a04-v15.plain_english: But practice in the supreme tattva, in the Siva-self, in one's own nature, is simply not possible.
tsa-a04-v15.sanskrit_cite: abhyāsaś ca pare tattve śivātmani svasvabhāve na saṃbhavaty eva

tsa-a04-v16.plain_english: For one rooted in consciousness, practice is the form of fixing breath, mind and body — like carrying a load, knowing the scripture's meaning, dancing-practice; but in the form of consciousness nothing is to be taken and nothing removed — how then practice?
tsa-a04-v16.sanskrit_cite: saṃvidrūḍhasya prāṇabuddhidehaniṣṭhīkaraṇarūpo hi abhyāsaḥ bhārodvahanaśāstrārthabodhanṛttābhyāsavat saṃvidrūpe tu na kiṃcit ādātavyaṃ na apasaraṇīyam iti katham abhyāsaḥ

tsa-a04-v17.plain_english: If it is asked — 'by reasoning too?' — it is said: this is only the mode of removing the residence-in-duality, nothing else at all.
tsa-a04-v17.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ tarkeṇāpi iti cet uktam atra dvaitādhivāsanirāsaprakāra eva ayaṃ na tu anyat kiṃcid iti

tsa-a04-v18.plain_english: Even in ordinary practice: the manifesting of the desired form of body and the rest as consciousness-selfhood, and the contemplation of the absence of other forms — that alone is the purpose of practice.
tsa-a04-v18.sanskrit_cite: laukike 'pi vā abhyāse cidātmatvena sarvarūpasya tasya tasya dehādeḥ abhimatarūpatāprakaṭīkaraṇaṃ taditararūpanyagbhāvanaṃ ca iti eṣa eva abhyāsārthaḥ

tsa-a04-v19.plain_english: But in the supreme tattva nothing at all is to be discarded, it is said.
tsa-a04-v19.sanskrit_cite: paratattve tu na kiṃcit apāsyam iti uktam

tsa-a04-v20.plain_english: The residence-in-duality too, mark well, is not some separate thing-existing: it is mere own-nature-manifestation — hence the rejection of duality is done by concept, from the saying.
tsa-a04-v20.sanskrit_cite: dvaitādhivāso 'pi nāma na kaścana pṛthak vastubhūtaḥ api tu svarūpākhyātimātraṃ tat ato dvaitāpāsanaṃ vikalpena kriyata ity ukteḥ

tsa-a04-v21.plain_english: This supreme truth, own-nature shining as the form of manifestation, is taken by itself from autonomy; by the order — thrown off, turned toward expansion, then expanding, then expanded — it shines in this way; and the shining too is the Supreme Lord's own nature — so here the yoga-limbs are not the direct means.
tsa-a04-v21.sanskrit_cite: ayaṃ paramārthaḥ svarūpaṃ prakāśamānam akhyātirūpatvaṃ svayaṃ svātantryāt gṛhītaṃ krameṇa projjhya vikāsonmukham atha vikasat atha vikasitam ity anena krameṇa prakāśate tathā prakāśanam api parameśvarasya svarūpam eva tasmāt na atra yogāṅgāni sākṣāt upāyaḥ

tsa-a04-v22.plain_english: Reason may favor it, but true-reason alone is the direct means there; it is pure knowledge too, and is impressed in many forms: offering, fire-offering, recitation, vow, yoga. Therein the abode of all states is the Supreme Lord alone — nothing separate exists; for the establishment of conviction in concept, the offering of all states to the Supreme Lord itself is the offering — from heart-nature, the offering in the Supreme Lord is easy for those who themselves show entry into consciousness; hence the external use of flower, satisfaction, scent and the rest was declared.
tsa-a04-v22.sanskrit_cite: tarkaṃ tu anugṛhṇīyur api sattarka eva sākṣāt tatra upāyaḥ sa eva ca śuddhavidyā sa ca bahuprakāratayā saṃskṛto bhavati tadyathā yāgo homo japo vrataṃ yoga iti tatra bhāvānāṃ sarveṣāṃ parameśvara eva sthitiḥ nānyat vyatiriktam asti iti vikalparūḍhisiddhaye parameśvara eva sarvabhāvārpaṇaṃ yāgaḥ sa ca hṛdyatvāt ye saṃvidanupraveśaṃ svayam eva bhajante teṣāṃ suśakaṃ parameśvare arpaṇam ity abhiprāyeṇa hṛdyānāṃ kusumatarpaṇagandhādīnāṃ bahir upayoga uktaḥ

tsa-a04-v23.plain_english: All states are made of the light of the Supreme Lord: for the attainment of the convicted concept, in the light of the Supreme Lord's consciousness-fire, in the desire to swallow all states — the sudden dissolution of all states into the residue of mere light: that is the fire-offering.
tsa-a04-v23.sanskrit_cite: sarve bhāvāḥ parameśvaratejomayā iti rūḍhavikalpaprāptyai parameśasaṃvidanalatejasi samastabhāvagrāsarasikatābhimate tattejomātrāvaśeṣatvasahasamastabhāvavilāpanaṃ homaḥ

tsa-a04-v24.plain_english: Likewise, for the arising of the both-natured contemplation, by disregard alone of the states divided by outer, inner and other knowable forms: that supreme tattva is formed of one's own nature — the inner contemplation is the recitation.
tsa-a04-v24.sanskrit_cite: tathā ubhayātmakaparāmarśodayārthaṃ bāhyābhyantarādiprameyarūpabhinnabhāvānapekṣayaiva evaṃvidhaṃ tat paraṃ tattvaṃ svasvabhāvabhūtam iti antaḥ parāmarśanaṃ japaḥ

tsa-a04-v25.plain_english: For the gaining everywhere-always of the impersonal identification with the Supreme Lord, by the identification of equality with the Supreme Lord: the viewing even of the body, even of a pot and the rest, is the vow.
tsa-a04-v25.sanskrit_cite: sarvatra sarvadā nirupāyaparameśvarābhimānalābhāya parameśvarasamatābhimānena dehasyāpi ghaṭāder api avalokanaṃ vratam

tsa-a04-v26.plain_english: As said in the Śrī-Nandiśikhā: all-equality is the supreme vow.
tsa-a04-v26.sanskrit_cite: yathoktaṃ śrīnandiśikhāyām sarvasāmyaṃ paraṃ vratam iti

tsa-a04-v27.plain_english: Thus, by various concepts formed of portions of pure knowledge, what concept-independent, natural, supreme-truth tattva shines — for establishment in being merely the eternal shining of that kind, the specific concept that tracks its own nature: that is yoga.
tsa-a04-v27.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ vicitraiḥ śuddhavidyāṃśarūpaiḥ vikalpaiḥ yat anapekṣitavikalpaṃ svābhāvikaṃ paramārthatattvaṃ prakāśate tasyaiva sanātanatathāvidhaprakāśamātratārūḍhaye tatsvarūpānusaṃdhānātmā vikalpaviśeṣo yogaḥ

tsa-a04-v28.plain_english: Therein the Supreme Lord, of the nature of full consciousness — fullness is his power, clan, capability, wave, heart, essence, pulsation, glory; the triad, Kālī, Karṣaṇī, Caṇḍī, Vāṇī, enjoyment, vision, Nityā and the rest — is denoted by the scriptural languages that run according to each sense; by that, by that form, let it be in the hearts of the meditators.
tsa-a04-v28.sanskrit_cite: tatra parameśvaraḥ pūrṇasaṃvitsvabhāvaḥ pūrṇataiva asya śaktiḥ kulaṃ sāmarthyam ūrmiḥ hṛdayaṃ sāraṃ spandaḥ vibhūtiḥ trīśikā kālī karṣaṇī caṇḍī vāṇī bhogo dṛk nityā ityādibhiḥ āgamabhāṣābhiḥ tattadanvarthapravṛttābhiḥ abhidhīyate tena tena rūpeṇa dhyāyināṃ hṛdi āstām iti

tsa-a04-v29.plain_english: And she shines as fullness-consciousness by the seeing of the nature of the whole power.

tsa-a04-v31.plain_english: Why say more? The world — those are his powers; how can they be taught?
tsa-a04-v31.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ bahunā yat viśvaṃ tā asya śaktayaḥ tāḥ katham upadeṣṭuṃ śakyāḥ iti

tsa-a04-v32.plain_english: In three the world is completed: by which this bears, sees and illumines up to the bearer-limit of Śiva as mere uncaricatured consciousness-form — the Supreme Lord; that is his Śrīparā-power.
tsa-a04-v32.sanskrit_cite: tisṛṣu tāvat viśvaṃ samāpyate yayā idaṃ śivādidharaṇyantam avikalpyasaṃvinmātrarūpatayā bibharti ca paśyati ca bhāsayati ca parameśvaraḥ sā asya śrīparaśaktiḥ

tsa-a04-v33.plain_english: By which, like a mirror or an elephant and the rest, by difference and undifference — that is his Śrīparāparā-power.
tsa-a04-v33.sanskrit_cite: yayā ca darpaṇahastyādivat bhedābhedābhyāṃ sā asya śrīparāparaśaktiḥ

tsa-a04-v34.plain_english: By which, with the self distinct from one another, by difference alone — that is his Śrīmadaparā-power.
tsa-a04-v34.sanskrit_cite: yayā parasparaviviktātmanā bhedenaiva sā asya śrīmadaparaśaktiḥ

tsa-a04-v35.plain_english: By which the threefold holding of this, in the self itself, by embracing, in the form of tracking, grasps — she is the Goddess Śrīparā herself, named by other words such as Śrīmat-mātṛ, sat-bhāva, kāla, karṣiṇī.
tsa-a04-v35.sanskrit_cite: etat trividhaṃ yayā dhāraṇam ātmany eva kroḍīkāreṇa anusandhānātmanā grasate sā asya bhagavatī śrīparaiva śrīmanmātṛsadbhāvakālakarṣiṇyādiśabdāntaraniruktā

tsa-a04-v36.plain_english: These four powers, from autonomy, each operates threefold alone.
tsa-a04-v36.sanskrit_cite: tā etāḥ catasraḥ śaktayaḥ svātantryāt pratyekaṃ tridhaiva vartante

tsa-a04-v37.plain_english: In creation, preservation and dissolution — twelve they become.
tsa-a04-v37.sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭau sthitau saṃhāre ca iti dvādaśa bhavanti

tsa-a04-v38.plain_english: Thus consciousness first constructs the state within; then outside too by distinctness; taking reddened-nature right there; then, with the intention to reabsorb that state within; then it forms the doubt that is the obstacle to reabsorption, and grasps it; the doubt-grasped portion of the state it constructs in the self by reabsorption; then it constructs even the reabsorber-nature — my-this-form — as its own nature; then, in constructing the reabsorber-nature, the standing of some state by habit-nature, and of some, the residue-of-consciousness-merely; then, by being inseparable from the construction of own-nature, the instrument-wheel; then even the instrument-Lord; then it constructs the māyic knower-form too; it constructs the knower who is contraction-and-release-turned, expansion-grasping, taste-loving; therefore the expanded form too it constructs — thus these twelve Goddess-consciousnesses, directing one knower-object or even several, simultaneously or in order, two-wise, three-wise, even-standing, and arising-portioned, revolving like a wheel, outside too by the order of month, segment and asterism, and within too by the order of pot, cloth and the rest, shining, nourishing the autonomy of the wheel-Lord, denoted by the word Śrīkālī.
tsa-a04-v38.sanskrit_cite: tathā hi saṃvit pūrvam antar eva bhāvaṃ kalayati tato bahir api sphuṭatayā kalayati tatraiva raktimayatāṃ gṛhītvā tataḥ tam eva bhāvam antar upasaṃjihīrṣayā kalayati tataś ca tadupasaṃhāravighnabhūtāṃ śaṅkāṃ nirmiṇoti ca grasate ca grastaśaṅkāṃśaṃ bhāvabhāgam ātmani upasaṃhāreṇa kalayati tata upasaṃhartṛtvaṃ mamedaṃ rūpam ity api svabhāvam eva kalayati tata upasaṃhartṛsvabhāvakalane kasyacid bhāvasya vāsanātmanā avasthitiṃ kasyacit tu saṃvinmātrāvaśeṣatāṃ kalayati tataḥ svarūpakalanānāntarīyakatvenaiva karaṇacakraṃ kalayati tataḥ karaṇeśvaram api kalayati tataḥ kalpitaṃ māyīyaṃ pramātṛrūpam api kalayati saṅkocatyāgonmukhavikāsagrahaṇarasikam api pramātāraṃ kalayati ato vikasitam api rūpaṃ kalayati iti etā dvādaśa bhagavatyaḥ saṃvidaḥ pramātṝn ekaṃ vāpi uddiśya yugapat krameṇa dviśaḥ triśa ityādisthityāpi udayabhāginyaḥ cakravad āvartamānā bahir api māsakalārāśyādikrameṇa antato vā ghaṭapaṭādikrameṇāpi bhāsamānāḥ cakreśvarasya svātantryaṃ puṣṇatyaḥ śrīkālīśabdavācyāḥ

tsa-a04-v39.plain_english: And construction is motion, throw, knowledge, counting, enjoyment-making, sound, and self-dissolving too.
tsa-a04-v39.sanskrit_cite: kalanaṃ ca gatiḥ kṣepo jñānaṃ gaṇanaṃ bhogīkaraṇaṃ śabdanaṃ svātmalayīkaraṇaṃ ca

tsa-a04-v40.plain_english: As the Śrībhūtirāja-teachers say: from the throw and from the knowledge, Kālī — by subjection to construction, then.
tsa-a04-v40.sanskrit_cite: yad āhuḥ śrībhūtirājaguravaḥ kṣepāj jñānāc ca kālī kalanavaśatayātha iti

tsa-a04-v41.plain_english: And this meaning is to be considered where it is spread in my composed commentary, in the treatise, hymn and the rest.
tsa-a04-v41.sanskrit_cite: eṣa ca arthaḥ tatra tatra madviracite vivaraṇe prakaraṇastotrādau vitatya vīkṣyaḥ

tsa-a04-v42.plain_english: Not too secret to be shown somewhere, nor to be hidden in every way — so our teachers.
tsa-a04-v42.sanskrit_cite: na atirahasyam ekatra khyāpyaṃ na ca sarvathā gopyam iti hi asmadguravaḥ

tsa-a04-v43.plain_english: Thus what was said — offering, fire-offering and the rest: in this kind the Great-Lord alone is to be thought.
tsa-a04-v43.sanskrit_cite: tad evam yad uktaṃ yāgahomādi tat evaṃvidhe maheśvara eva mantavyam

tsa-a04-v44.plain_english: All see Viṣṇu-to-Siva as the ground-form only of what is to be rejected, of what is to be accepted; and that false view is necessarily to be abandoned by unsurpassable yogins — for that very reason the knowledge-Lord's great fervor in the hymn of experience: in this kind, in offering and the rest, at the end of yoga, in the fivefold, each many-form establishment; as it becomes, so let him practice — not by discriminating edible and inedible, clean and unclean and the rest, by abandoning thing-qualities, by a fancy-merely-essence tormenting the self. For purity is not the form of a thing like blueness elsewhere, from the command of impurity on it; like the gift's command in initiation — if 'it is impure there' by another command too the same, other-command not-existing from being overridden — if not, the obstructive power of Siva's command alone is established by reason, and established by the omniscient, unsurpassable, endless scripture too — we will say.
tsa-a04-v44.sanskrit_cite: sarve hi heyam eva upādeyabhūmirūpaṃ viṣṇutaḥ prabhṛti śivāntaṃ paramaśivatayā paśyanti tac ca mithyādarśanam avaśyatyājyam anuttarayogibhir iti tadartham eva vidyādhipateḥ anubhavastotre mahān saṃrambhaḥ evaṃvidhe yāgādau yogānte ca pañcake pratyekaṃ bahuprakāraṃ nirūḍhiḥ yathā yathā bhavati tathaiva ācaret na tu bhakṣyābhakṣyaśuddhyaśuddhyādivivecanayā vastudharmojjhitayā kalpanāmātrasārayā svātmā khedanīya iti uktaṃ śrīpūrvādau na hi śuddhiḥ vastuno rūpaṃ nīlatvavat anyatra tasyaiva aśuddhicodanāt dānasyeva dīkṣitatve codanātaḥ tasya tat tatra aśuddham iti cet codanāntare 'pi tulyaṃ codanāntaram asat tadbādhitatvāt iti cet na śivacodanāyā eva bādhakatvaṃ yuktisiddhaṃ sarvajñānottarādyanantāgamasiddhaṃ ca iti vakṣyāmaḥ

tsa-a04-v45.plain_english: Therefore from the Vedic on, spoken in the Pārameśvara-system, tantra, clan, Ucchuṣma and other scriptures too, whatever restraint or injunction or prohibition — here it is established as of no effect whatsoever.
tsa-a04-v45.sanskrit_cite: tasmāt vaidikāt prabhṛti pārameśvarasiddhāntatantrakulocchuṣmādiśāstrokto 'pi yo niyamo vidhiḥ vā niṣedho vā so 'tra yāvad akiṃcitkara eva iti siddham

tsa-a04-v46.plain_english: Likewise it is said in the Śrīpūrva-and-rest, spread — from the Tantrāloka it is to be sought.
tsa-a04-v46.sanskrit_cite: tathaiva ca uktaṃ śrīpūrvādau vitatya tantrālokāt anveṣyam

essence: Concept impresses in sequence for entry — the contemplation-sequence preceded by true reason/scripture/teacher has use.
By concept-strength beings mistake themselves bound; the counter-pair concept tears that cause and becomes prosperity's cause.
The crossing-concept: undelimited-consciousness-merely-formed = paramārtha, world-ojas, the breath of world — aham world-self.
Not for the māyā-blind: true-reason and rest absent.
Vaiṣṇava-type āgamas passion-limited: no higher inclination, hostile to sattarka-lineage.
Pārameśvara cites them: colored by vidyā-rāga.
They lack sarvajña-jñāna, hence find not parama-tattva.
Only firm-śaktipāta-pierced, impressing concept by true-scripture-order, enter supreme own-nature.
Concept is not paramārtha's form: its work is only dvaita-breaking; paramārtha is self-luminous everywhere.
Firmly-pierced get sattarka spontaneously — that is devī-dīkṣā.
Another gets it by scripture-order — full treatment in power-descent-revelation.
Sattarka-task = teacher-scripture determination + fitting-concept arising; that chain = sattarka = bhāvanā making existent look non-existent.
No yoga-limb is direct means apart from sattarka: limbs are vedyamātra, sattarka alone works in saṃvid.
Limbs still excellence the karaṇa-bhūmi and impart tādātmya — subordinate but real.
Abhyāsa cannot exist in parama-tattva-Siva-self: practice presupposes otherness.
Rooted-in-saṃvid: practice = fixing breath-mind-body; in saṃvid-form nothing taken or removed — how practice?
Tarka admitted only as dvaita-nirāsa-prakāra — nothing else.
Laukika-abhyāsa = cid-ātmatā manifestation + other-form absence — that is its purpose.
In para-tattva nothing is to be discarded.
Dvaitādhivāsa is no separate thing: mere own-nature-manifestation — so removal is by concept.
Paramārtha shines by the order thrown-off→expansion→expanded from svātantrya; shining is svarūpa — limbs not direct means.
Sattarka alone direct even where tarka favors: it is śuddhavidyā impressed as yāga/homa/japa/vrata/yoga — all states' abode the Lord; external scaffolding for heart-nature.
Homa: all states Lord-light; swallowing-taste in Lord-consciousness-fire; sudden dissolution to mere light-residue.
Japa: inner contemplation of own-nature-tattva, disregarding outer/inner-knowable divisions.
Vrata: equality-identification everywhere — even body and pot viewed as Lord.
Nandiśikhā cites: all-equality the supreme vow.
Yoga: specific concept tracking svarūpa until paramārtha shines concept-independent — self-liquidating instrument.
Parameśvara denoted by āgama-names each anvartha-running from pūrṇasaṃvit: fullness his power, Kālī etc. — let it be in meditators' hearts.
By seeing whole-power-nature, fullness-consciousness shines.
His powers are countless — the world itself is the unteachable list.
Why teach them? World = his powers.
Śrīparā: bearer-seer-illuminator up to Śiva-limit as avikalpa-saṃvid — completes world in three.
Śrīparāparā: difference-undifference like mirror-elephant.
Śrīmadaparā: difference alone, mutually distinct selfhood.
Śrīparā again: holds the threefold in self by embrace-tracking — named Śrīmat-mātṛ-sat-bhāva-kāla-karṣiṇī.
Four powers from autonomy each triple: 4×3 in creation/preservation/dissolution = twelve.
Four powers triple through creation, preservation, dissolution: twelve they become.
The twelve-fold saṃvit-kalana runs the full constructive cycle — twelve Goddesses, wheel-revolving, cosmic and domestic scales, nourishing cakreśvara-svātantrya: Śrīkālī.
Kalana's range: motion, throw, knowledge, counting, enjoyment-making, sound, self-dissolving.
Bhūtirāja-teachers: from throw and knowledge Kālī, by subjection to construction.
Distributed across my vivaraṇa treatises and hymns.
House-rule: neither too-secret nor fully hidden — graduated disclosure.
Yāga-homa and rest: in this kind the Great-Lord alone is to be thought.
Fierce claim: heya/upādeya-seeing Viṣṇu-to-Siva is mithyā-darśana to be abandoned; practice as-it-becomes, not purity-fancy tormenting self; purity is command-relative; Siva's-command alone binds.
From Vedic through Ucchuṣma scriptures: whatever restraint/injunction here akiṃcitkara — established.
Likewise said in Śrīpūrva: spread — from Tantrāloka to be sought.

rasa.dominant: karuṇā with vīrya weight (compassion carrying fierce argument)
rasa.justification: The relish is contest becoming clarity: refutations land hard (maivam, na kiṃcit, akiṃcitkara), yet each denial clears space for the Lord-only practice — the u44 fervour is compassion for those trapped in purity-fancy, not scorn; the twelve-Goddess passage (u38) is its single luminous swell.

Śrīmadaparā: difference alone, mutually distinct selfhood. Śrīparā again: holds the threefold in self by embrace-tracking — named Śrīmat-mātṛ-sat-bhāva-kāla-karṣiṇī. Four powers from autonomy each triple: 4×3 in creation/preservation/dissolution = twelve. Four powers triple through creation, preservation, dissolution: twelve they become. The twelve-fold saṃvit-kalana runs the full constructive cycle — twelve Goddesses, wheel-revolving, cosmic and domestic scales, nourishing cakreśvara-svātantrya: Śrīkālī. Kalana's range: motion, throw, knowledge, counting, enjoyment-making, sound, self-dissolving. Bhūtirāja-teachers: from throw and knowledge Kālī, by subjection to construction. Distributed across my vivaraṇa treatises and hymns. House-rule: neither too-secret nor fully hidden — graduated disclosure. Yāga-homa and rest: in this kind the Great-Lord alone is to be thought. Fierce claim: heya/upādeya-seeing Viṣṇu-to-Siva is mithyā-darśana to be abandoned; practice as-it-becomes, not purity-fancy tormenting self; purity is command-relative; Siva's-command alone binds. From Vedic through Ucchuṣma scriptures: whatever restraint/injunction here akiṃcitkara — established. Likewise said in Śrīpūrva: spread — from Tantrāloka to be sought.
sections.FUNCTION: Establishes vikalpa as the conditioned upāya (sattarka-lineage), subordinates yoga-limbs to saṃvid-work, defines the five practices as sattarka's impress-forms (yāga→yoga), unfolds the four Śaktis ×3 = twelve, the twelve-fold saṃvit-kalana as Śrīkālī, and the radical codanā-argument that only Śiva's command binds.
sections.KEY TERMS: sattarka (true-reason as fitting scriptural concept-chain); dvaitādhivāsa-bhaṅga (concept's sole work); śaktipāta-viddha (firm-pierced, devī-dīkṣā); the five practices as sakti-forms (yāga/homa/japa/vrata/yoga); catuḥ-śakti (Śrīparā/parāparā/madaparā + kroḍī-holder); dvādaśa-bhagavatī (twelve kalana-Goddesses = Śrīkāli); codanā-vaśa (command-relativity of purity); akiṃcitkara-niyama (foreign-restraint nullity).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 4 answers a03's doctrine with the vikalpa-question (v1-21), the practice-forms (v22-27), then the śakti/kalana-cosmology (v28-40) and the purity-controversy (v41-46); v11 defers to śaktipāta-prakāśana; v44-46 cross-link anubhava-stotra, Śrīpūrva, Tantrāloka.
sections.BOUNDARY: Sattarka's two-track (spontaneous vs sequential) left unexpanded (deferred); kalana's twelve-fold steps asserted without each-step exegesis; codanā-hierarchy argued but 'we will say' (v44) defers the full scriptural proof; v46 leaves the Tantrāloka-search open.
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika argues in four moves: (1) vikalpa's conditions and limits — who gets sattarka, what it does (dvaita-bhanga only), why limbs are not direct means; (2) the five practices re-read as one sarvabhāva-arpaṇa to maheśvara, each an impress-form of sattarka-as-śuddhavidyā; (3) cosmology: four Śaktis by svātantrya triple to twelve, the twelve-fold kalana of saṃvid (the Śrīkālī-text) with its seven-operation semantics; (4) the purity-argument: heya/upādeya-seeing is mithyā, purity is codanā-relative, foreign niyamas are akiṃcitkara here. Authority: Pārameśvara, Nandiśikhā, Bhūtirāja, own vivaraṇa, Śrīpūrva, Tantrāloka.
